panels.title: Runs: release version -> log stream (newest first)
panels.description: Decoder mapping each run's release version (RUN_NAME) and source tag (NLM_CKN_TAG) to its log stream. Top row = latest run. Paste a @logStream into the `run` dashboard variable to pin all panels to it.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| filter @message like /Release: tag=/
| parse @message /Release: tag=(?<source_tag>\S+)\s+run=(?<run_version>\S+)/
| stats min(@timestamp) as started by run_version, source_tag, @logStream
| sort started desc
| limit 50

panels.title: Flow & subflow results
panels.description: `Flow run '..' - Finished in state ..` lines. Look for Completed vs Failed; the top-level flow is the nlm-ckn-release one.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| filter @message like /Flow run/ and @message like /Finished in state/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

panels.title: 1. Release tasks (nlm-ckn-release)
panels.description: Top-level release flow: pull the release tarball, push it to S3, decide fetch-force, and (at the end) promote results to latest.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| parse @message /Task run '(?<taskfull>[^']+)' - Finished in state (?<state>\w+)/
| filter ispresent(taskfull)
| parse taskfull /(?<taskbase>.+)-[0-9a-z]{3}$/
| fields coalesce(taskbase, taskfull) as task
| filter task in ["extract-release-tarball", "sync-release-dir-to-s3", "resolve-fetch-force", "promote-results-to-latest"]
| stats latest(state) as last_state, count(*) as runs, latest(@timestamp) as finished_at by @logStream, task
| sort @logStream desc, finished_at asc
| limit 500

panels.title: 2. Fetch tasks (nlm-ckn-fetch)
panels.description: External-API fetch subflow. The shared sync/validate util tasks are listed here (they also run in etl); `runs` counts every invocation.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| parse @message /Task run '(?<taskfull>[^']+)' - Finished in state (?<state>\w+)/
| filter ispresent(taskfull)
| parse taskfull /(?<taskbase>.+)-[0-9a-z]{3}$/
| fields coalesce(taskbase, taskfull) as task
| filter task in ["sync-results-from-s3", "validate-release-dir", "sync-external-from-s3", "clean-empty-external-files", "retry-failed-cache-entries", "fetch-external-api-results", "transform-external-api-results", "validate-external-files", "record-fetch-artifact", "sync-external-to-s3-staging", "promote-external-staging"]
| stats latest(state) as last_state, count(*) as runs, latest(@timestamp) as finished_at by @logStream, task
| sort @logStream desc, finished_at asc
| limit 500

panels.title: 3. ETL tasks (nlm-ckn-etl)
panels.description: ETL subflow: build ontology/results/induced graphs, write tuples, create analyzers/views, and promote to production.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| parse @message /Task run '(?<taskfull>[^']+)' - Finished in state (?<state>\w+)/
| filter ispresent(taskfull)
| parse taskfull /(?<taskbase>.+)-[0-9a-z]{3}$/
| fields coalesce(taskbase, taskfull) as task
| filter task in ["ensure-jar", "stop-arangodb", "start-arangodb", "require-arangodb", "download-ontologies", "slim-ontologies", "build-ontology-graph", "dump-arangodb", "export-graphs-and-analyzers", "import-graphs-from-sidecar", "restore-arangodb", "sync-baseline-dump-to-s3", "sync-baseline-dump-from-s3", "sync-results-dump-to-s3", "sync-results-dump-from-s3", "write-tuples", "sync-tuples-to-s3", "validate-tuple-files", "build-results-graph", "build-induced-subgraph", "create-analyzers-and-views", "promote-to-production"]
| stats latest(state) as last_state, count(*) as runs, latest(@timestamp) as finished_at by @logStream, task
| sort @logStream desc, finished_at asc
| limit 500

panels.title: Failures & errors
panels.description: ERROR-level logs, failed states, and tracebacks. Empty here = the runs in range had no errors.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| filter @message like /Finished in state Failed/ or @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /Traceback/ or @message like /CalledProcessError/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: Vertices / edges / triples per run
panels.description: Graph load metrics parsed from `Constructed/Inserted N edges|vertices` and `N triples` lines, one row per run, newest first. Cross-reference @logStream with the decoder table for the release version.

targets.expression:
fields @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| parse @message /Constructed (?<edges>\d+) edges from (?<triples>\d+) triples/
| parse @message /Inserted (?<edges_ins>\d+) edges/
| parse @message /Constructed (?<vertices>\d+) vertices/
| parse @message /Inserted (?<vertices_ins>\d+) vertices/
| filter ispresent(edges) or ispresent(edges_ins) or ispresent(vertices) or ispresent(vertices_ins)
| stats min(@timestamp) as started, max(triples) as triples_total, max(vertices) as vertices_built, max(vertices_ins) as vertices_inserted, max(edges) as edges_built, max(edges_ins) as edges_inserted by @logStream
| sort started desc
| limit 50

panels.title: Tuples written per run
panels.description: Sum of `Wrote N tuples to ...` across all NSForest files in each run, newest first. Cross-reference @logStream with the decoder table.

targets.expression:
fields @logStream, @message
| filter @logStream like "$run"
| parse @message /Wrote (?<n>\d+) tuples/
| filter ispresent(n)
| stats min(@timestamp) as started, sum(n) as total_tuples, count(n) as tuple_files by @logStream
| sort started desc
| limit 50
